series: Rust Projects (long videos, every other day)
note: Each project is ~10-14 min, built and run for real (longform/LONGFORM.md). Take the first project whose slug is not in state/longform_history.json.

projects.title: Build a Todo CLI App in Rust (clap + serde)
projects.covers: structs, enums, match, Vec, closures, JSON files, clap subcommands, release build, cargo install

projects.title: Build a File Organizer in Rust (sort your Downloads)
projects.covers: std::fs, paths, walkdir, HashMap by extension, dry-run flag, error handling with ?

projects.title: Rewrite `wc` in Rust (lines, words, bytes) with Tests
projects.covers: reading files and stdin, iterators, #[test], cargo test, comparing with the real wc

projects.title: Build a Secure Password Generator in Rust
projects.covers: rand, character sets, CLI options, unit tests, entropy explained

projects.title: Markdown to HTML Converter in Rust
projects.covers: pulldown-cmark, reading/writing files, templates, a watch-free build step

projects.title: Analyze Server Logs in Rust (fast!)
projects.covers: regex, BufReader, HashMap counting, top-N, timing vs a shell pipeline

projects.title: CSV Expense Report Generator in Rust
projects.covers: csv + serde, grouping and totals, formatted tables, error handling

projects.title: Build a REST API in Rust with Axum
projects.covers: axum routes, JSON in/out, shared state with Arc<Mutex>, curl testing

projects.title: Rust REST API + SQLite Database

projects.title: Build a URL Shortener in Rust

projects.title: Multi-User Chat Server in Rust (Tokio)

projects.title: Build a Mini Key-Value Store in Rust

projects.title: System Monitor CLI in Rust (CPU, RAM, processes)

projects.title: Batch Image Thumbnail Generator in Rust

projects.title: Static Site Generator in Rust

projects.title: File Backup Tool with Hashing in Rust

projects.title: Rate-Limit an API in Rust (Axum middleware)

projects.title: Live WebSocket Dashboard in Rust
